subject: Yamal and a Raphinha double sink Aston Villa 3-0 at Camp Nou
title: Yamal and Raphinha, Villa undone

lines.vo: Perfect European record, meet Camp Nou.
Villa arrived on a three-game winning run. Barcelona won three-nil.
lines.footage: Yamal goal Aston Villa Champions League

lines.vo: Yamal scored in the seventh minute. Villa's defence was still putting its boots on.
Raphinha added two more. One deflected, one a simple tap-in. Easy work.
Unai Emery said his side lacked a clinical edge. Polite for: we missed, they did not.
Yamal is now the competition's top teenage scorer. Kylian Mbappe is second. Do not tell him.
Raphinha has nineteen goals in thirteen games this season. Defenders across Europe are checking holiday flights.
Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.
